
DESCRIPTION
Switch the current local connection

USAGE
  one configure use [service-id] [--profile <name>] [--workspace] [--project <name|path>] [flags]

COMMON OPTIONS
  -o, --output <value>     Output format: json | yaml | text (default: terminal-friendly text, JSON when piped)

AUTOMATION AND ADVANCED OPTIONS
  --profile <value>        Existing local-connection name; interactive terminals may select one
  -p, --project <value>    Use this connection for one project in the current workspace
  --workspace              Use this connection for the current workspace
